title: Corrupted lpfs project data

setup.describe: NEEDS REDESIGN (2026-08-03, three attempts — see FINDINGS.md): external partition garble cannot produce `unreadable`; it either bounces off littlefs redundancy, wedges the firmware, or reformats to empty. The right injection is OVER THE WIRE: start from s3 (firmware + project), then overwrite the loaded project's project.json with garbage via the filesystem API (lp-cli or a wire write), leaving the fs mountable. Until that exists, SKIP.

manual: The card should surface the unreadable/recovery path, not hang on Checking.
